title: Chained core+polish audio demonstration: FFT/mel primitive -> SpeechT5 mel predictor core -> HiFi-GAN vocoder polish -> M266a Whisper re-transcription (WER)
question: Is the in-system core+polish chain measured, auditable, and deterministic — and what does the end-to-end re-transcription WER read?

0_primitive.role: FFT/mel front-end as a PROGRAMMATIC PRIMITIVE; input-guard feature space + replay hash

1_core.role: frozen text->mel predictor (vocoder=None -> mel spectrogram output)

eval_instrument.role: the SEALED M266a protocol: re-transcribe the synthesized waveform; loop WER vs source text

speaker.note: the cmu-arctic-xvectors dataset is GATED (401) — instead a FIXED registered speaker-conditioning vector is used (seeded L2-normalized 512-d); voice naturalness is NOT the gate, the measured chain loop is

sentences.source: LibriSpeech test-clean transcripts (head rows, registered count)

gates.g2_primitive_replay: stage-0 output replays from its payload hash
gates.g3_chain_determinism: two runs of the full chain produce identical content hashes (timing excluded)
gates.g4_ledger_replay: the decision path is orchestrator-ledger recorded and verifies
gates.g5_loop_wer: synthesized speech re-transcribed by the sealed M266a protocol; WER recorded
